project: Before the Rain / 雨来之前
direction: Original code-native garden cartoons; shared leaf/ink shapes, readable weather shield, diamond dew versus round rain, broad shelters and a distant home light. No generated bitmaps or imported reference assets.

code_native_art.collision_contract: Model authoritative, unchanged player physics. Only the player has collision and stamina. Rescued actors are bounded screen-plane departure animations with no physics or damage; follow/path and companion collision-offset logic removed. Full solid stem rectangles remain visible, flower direction and shelter position remain model-derived.
code_native_art.frame: Godot 4.6.2, Compatibility renderer, 1280x800 logical frame, keep-aspect, code-native AA outlines; no bitmap texture budget.

ui.source: Project Godot drawing and controls in main.gd; operating-system Chinese font fallback
ui.stamina: Five 20-point segments, numeric current stamina, pending burst cost highlight and delayed loss trail
ui.clock: Elapsed journey clock in levels 1-2; exposed-time budget labeled 露天 in levels 3-4. Separate spatial storm indicator names chase/near/escaped/sheltered states.
ui.handoff: 2.4-second in-world landing at every earned goal; Enter skips, pause/focus loss freezes; finish immediately stops gameplay and saves. Final landing precedes ending card. Continuing a saved nonfinal arrival enters the next stage.
ui.progress: Twenty spatial encounters share nine ordered save areas (2/2/3/2). Six purpose-authored dew (2/1/3/0), no collection quota during homecoming. Eight friends distributed 4/2/1/1; separate v4 content revision 6 preserves old v3 progress. Rescue still saves immediately; departure never persists. Compatible optional arrived flag in v4/rev6; 0.5.1 files remain readable. Level 02 dew moved to the route-split approach without changing entity indices.
ui.local_feedback: Actionable contextual cues retained; spent-flower text hidden because folded petals show the same result.

rejected_pass.status: Removed from source/runtime/export following user feedback SF-R02: AI feeling too strong.
rejected_pass.retention: Original unchanged images, full image-generation prompts/provenance, native captures and interim app retained only in local outputs/swarm-flight/2026-10-20-finished-chapter/rejected-painted-pass; not required at runtime.

validation.engine: Godot 4.6.2 stable, OpenGL Compatibility on Apple M1 Pro
validation.result: 0.5.2: 452 model checks, 130 headless UI and 167 native UI/capture checks passed. Old v4 compatibility, immediate arrival save, actual title continuation and failed-save/retry paths checked. Developer evidence only; this arrival revision awaits creator playthrough.
validation.rhythm_revision: 0.3.1 retains the original art and all music. Native input-route captures and technical checks recorded in the local rhythm-feedback delivery receipt; player feel acceptance remains pending.
validation.chapter_revision: 0.4.0 keeps all three original music arrangements unchanged; known-answer developer route is roughly 5-6 minutes, not evidence for the initial 20-30-minute first-play target.
validation.chase_revision: 0.4.1 retains map geometry, entity counts, control physics, stamina rewards and original music; authored section storm pace and clearer relay/chase feedback. Near-rain capture is an explicit UI state fixture, not a player run.
validation.living_revision: 0.4.2 retains all map, model, input, save and audio source. Revises silhouettes, action poses and bounded plant reactions. Real v2 progress is checked from an isolated copy, never overwritten by QA.
validation.rescue_revision: Existing geometry, resources, player collision, rain and music retained. Native ordinary-key rescue tests cover temporary departures, pause, active player control, expiry, recovery and restart; save continuation never replays rescue effects.
validation.facing_revision: 0.4.4 fixes left-facing body inversion using horizontal mirroring plus pitch; resting bodies settle level. Model, input, saves and sound unchanged. Native directional/charge/dash/rest captures and checks recorded in the upright-flight delivery receipt.
validation.chapter05_revision: Five authored encounters per stage, three broad saves per stage, 20 optional dew, rescue distribution 4/2/1/1. Direct, all-dew and no-shield ordinary-input paths complete. Shield-turn fixture uses no dash and finishes before expiry; elapsed time is a known-answer route measurement, not first-play time.
validation.pacing_revision: Dew authored as ordered optional beats, rescue refill carries into subsequent flight, nine deliberate shelters, six dew with dynamic save/UI counts. Weather follows encounter purpose. Direct/all-dew/no-shield/flow-through complete without recovery; recovery test uses five explicit returns after rescues. Flow-through rain route reaches 2.07 stamina, not novice-tolerance proof.
validation.arrival_revision: Level 02 supply precedes the route split. Crossing the goal aperture completes before same-substep weather damage; model/time/stamina freeze throughout presentation. All music generation functions remain byte-identical to 0.5.1; only arrival bell synthesis added.

style_references.use: Broad garden-cartoon visual reference only; no characters, sprites, logos or screenshots are shipped.
Official soundtrack context for light, playful garden mood; no audio download, transcription or melody reuse.

audio.source: Original deterministic PCM synthesis authored in project code. No external samples, recordings or transcriptions.
audio.arrangements: Three original eight-bar / 32-beat A/B arrangements, 64 eighth-note slots. Offbeat plucks, toy keys/wooden mallets, alternating bass root/fifth, light percussion. Third act shifts to minor harmony and denser pulse.
audio.mix: Fixed synthesis gain 1.45; 1.2s stage music crossfade, 4dB event duck, retained mute and fixed 8-voice SFX pool.
audio.verification_output: SWARM_AUDIO_DIR or OS cache directory/before-the-rain-audio-qa; three WAVs and signal-report.json. PCM checks are technical evidence, not human listening acceptance.
